sections.label: Public sector transformation plans
sections.summary: Public sector agencies are developing transformation plans and integrating services, starting with Moments-of-Life for Families to make government schemes more citizen-centric.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: All public sector agencies are developing plans to transform their operations and services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will further integrate the Public Service by grouping services provided by different agencies together for our citizens at key moments in their lives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We are starting with Moments-of-Life for Families, which aims to be more citizen-centric, intuitive and convenient for Singaporeans starting a family to access Government schemes.

sections.label: SkillsFuture and public officer training
sections.summary: Public officers will be equipped with skills, restructured career paths, engineering and ICT capabilities, data analytics training, and more flexible hiring practices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: In line with the SkillsFuture movement, we will also equip public officers with the skills necessary for tomorrow’s challenges.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: The Civil Service College has refreshed its training programmes and methods of delivery to meet these needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We have restructured career paths to give officers career progression opportunities, regardless of academic qualifications.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will also continue to build new capabilities for the Public Service to serve Singapore’s future needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: These include stronger engineering capabilities to develop our city infrastructure, and Information and Communications Technology (ICT) expertise to make us a Smart Nation and Digital Government.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We are training public officers in data analytics and digital literacy, so as to better understand citizens’ needs and improve public services.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Agencies will adopt more flexible and inclusive hiring practices, including hiring more persons with disabilities and freelancers.

sections.label: Leadership development efforts expanded
sections.summary: Leadership development efforts have expanded to cover specialist leaders from diverse backgrounds, with coaching, 360-degree assessments, and diverse experiences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Our leadership development efforts have expanded to cover specialist leaders in all fields and from more diverse backgrounds.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry and Minister-in-charge of the Public Service (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We are better equipping leaders to lead transformation efforts through coaching support, 360-degree assessments, and exposure to more diverse experiences.
